description: The file is an HTML document that implements a web-based database visualizer interface, including UI components and embedded JavaScript for dynamic data fetching and rendering.

methods.name: loadDatabases
methods.description: Fetches list of databases from server and updates the sidebar.

methods.name: refreshDatabases
methods.description: Refreshes the list of databases, updating UI and fetching data.

methods.name: toggleDatabase
methods.description: Expands or collapses the database entry to show tables.

methods.name: loadTables
methods.description: Loads tables for a selected database from server.

methods.name: loadTableData
methods.description: Fetches and displays data for a selected table.

methods.name: renderTable
methods.description: Renders fetched table data into an HTML table.

methods.name: renderCell
methods.description: Creates HTML for a table cell, handling objects, long strings, and nulls.

methods.name: expandCell
methods.description: Expands or collapses cell content to show full data.
